fullPassage: What is soft-path river engineering? One way to visualize its spirit is to liken it to a footpath in the forest. Suppose a tree falls across a footpath. A soft-path response would be simply to redirect the trail around the fallen tree. A more interventionist response would be to remove the tree and restore the original route. A still more interventionist response might be to straighten and pave the path to insert it more permanently in the landscape. The true high-modernist step would, of course, be to create a superhighway that removes the landscape and bulldozes straight through all obstacles in the topography. Soft-path engineering has the unique advantage of intellectual modesty with respect to what we actually know about river movement and its environmental effects. In contrast to hard-path engineering, soft-path engineering accepts variability in the river's movement as insignificant until proven otherwise. Backwaters, short-lived wetlands, braids and channels, swamps — all undesirable to hard-path engineering — are presumed by soft-path engineers to be ecologically important.

"the physical features of an area of land, including hills, valleys, and rivers"

det.korean: topography = 지형 (언덕, 계곡, 강 등 땅의 물리적 특징)
det.analysis:
❌ ① landscape
✅ ② topography
❌ ③ geography
❌ ④ territory
✅② topography: 지형 — 영영풀이와 일치
❌① landscape: 풍경, 경관
❌③ geography: 지리학
❌④ territory: 영토

questions.passage: A more interventionist response would be to remove the tree and restore the original route. A still more interventionist response might be to straighten and pave the path to insert it more __________ (permanent) in the landscape. The true high-modernist step would, of course, be to create a superhighway that removes the landscape and bulldozes straight through all obstacles in the topography.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (1단어) (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.korean: permanent(형용사) → permanently(부사). more permanently = 더 영구적으로.
det.analysis: insert it more permanently: more + 부사 = 비교급 부사

questions.passage: Soft-path engineering has the unique advantage of intellectual modesty with respect to what we actually know about river movement and its __________ (environment) effects.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (1단어) (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.korean: environment(명사) → environmental(형용사). environmental effects = 환경적 영향.
det.analysis: its environmental effects: 명사(effects) 앞에 형용사 필요

questions.passage: What is soft-path river engineering? One way to visualize its spirit is to liken it to a footpath in the forest. Suppose a tree falls across a footpath. A soft-path response would be simply to redirect the trail around the fallen tree. A more interventionist response would be to remove the tree and restore the original route. A still more interventionist response might be to straighten and pave the path to insert it more permanently in the landscape. The true high-modernist step would, of course, be to create a superhighway that removes the landscape and bulldozes straight through all obstacles in the topography. Soft-path engineering has the unique advantage of intellectual modesty with respect to what we actually know about river movement and its environmental effects. In contrast to hard-path engineering, soft-path engineering ____ as insignificant until proven otherwise. Backwaters, short-lived wetlands, braids and channels, swamps — all undesirable to hard-path engineering — are presumed by soft-path engineers to be ecologically important.
questions.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: creates permanent structures in the landscape
accepts variability in the river's movement

det.korean: soft-path engineering은 강의 움직임에서의 변동성을 수용한다(accepts variability).
det.analysis:
❌ ① eliminates all natural variability
❌ ② ignores the environmental effects
❌ ③ creates permanent structures in the landscape
✅ ④ accepts variability in the river's movement
✅④ accepts variability in the river's movement: 원문과 일치
❌① eliminates: 제거한다 — hard-path 접근
❌② ignores: 무시한다 — 문맥과 다름
❌③ creates permanent structures: hard-path 접근
det.tip: soft-path는 자연의 변동성을 수용(accept), hard-path는 제거(eliminate)하려 함

questions.passage: What is soft-path river engineering? One way to visualize its spirit is to liken it to a footpath in the forest. Suppose a tree falls across a footpath. A soft-path response would be simply to redirect the trail around the fallen tree. A more interventionist response would be to remove the tree and restore the original route. A still more interventionist response might be to straighten and pave the path to insert it more permanently in the landscape. The true high-modernist step would, of course, be to create a superhighway that removes the landscape and bulldozes straight through all obstacles in the topography. Soft-path engineering has the unique advantage of intellectual modesty with respect to what we actually know about river movement and its environmental effects. In contrast to hard-path engineering, soft-path engineering accepts variability in the river's movement as insignificant until proven otherwise. Backwaters, short-lived wetlands, braids and channels, swamps — all undesirable to hard-path engineering — are presumed by soft-path engineers to be ____.
questions.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: soft-path 엔지니어들은 이런 것들이 생태적으로 중요하다(ecologically important)고 추정한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① commercially valuable
❌ ② structurally unstable
✅ ③ ecologically important
❌ ④ aesthetically pleasing
✅③ ecologically important: 원문과 일치
❌① commercially valuable: 상업적 가치 — 문맥과 다름
❌② structurally unstable: 구조적 불안정 — 문맥과 다름
❌④ aesthetically pleasing: 미적으로 보기 좋은 — 문맥과 다름
det.tip: soft-path는 습지, 배수지 등을 생태적으로 중요한 것으로 봄
